title: Concept: Permissions-Policy grants the Payment Request API to every origin
description: A wildcard allowlist for the Payment Request API hands the payment sheet to every embedded frame, so third-party content can prompt the user in the page origin. The trust boundary of the checkout UI moves from the operator to any frame the page loads.
applicability: Responses that send Permissions-Policy and embed third-party frames.
risk: Third-party frames can present payment prompts attributed to the site, which is a consent and brand-integrity failure even before a payment credential is involved.
